████: Resurfaced under alias of "Dr. Alto Clef" at Special Containment Procedures Foundation.
Classified as Threat Level 1 (monitor, do not engage).

This might not really be a big deal but I find it kinda weird The GOC calls the foundation the Special Containment Procedures Foundation. In most stuff I've read on this site other goi's just call it The Foundation and sometimes The SCP Foundation. Once again I don't think it ruins the article or anything I just found this particular part kinda weird.
